title: WALL Pattern — live feed
description: One snapshot of live values for a wall. The source system sends a new snapshot on every update (push, poll or file drop). The wall works out deltas by comparing it with the previous snapshot and with the shift baseline.

generatedAt.description: When the source produced this snapshot. Drives the 'updated' time and stale detection.

sequence.description: Increments by one each snapshot. Lets the wall spot gaps or out-of-order arrivals.

values.description: Current value of every indicator, keyed by indicator id from the config.

baseline.description: Optional. Values at the start of the current window (shift, day or week), so 'since' deltas survive a wall restart. If missing, the wall uses the first snapshot it sees in each new window.

ages.description: Age of the oldest item per step, keyed by step id.

flows.description: Items that moved along each connector, keyed by connector id.

sinceShiftStart.description: Moved since the start of the current window (shift, day or week). Name kept from v0.1.

exceptions.description: All currently open exceptions. Ones missing since the previous snapshot are treated as resolved.

id.description: Stable id, so the wall can tell new from resolved.

type.description: Exception type id from the config.

ref.description: Record reference, e.g. unit or work order number.

messages.description: Optional extra lines for the 'What changed' panel that numbers alone can't express.
